services.name: Tickets
services.desc: We offer the car-centric trips below as fundraisers for CAM as well as fun travel opportunities for anyone interested! Taking place at the Goodwood Motor Circuit, outside Chichester, England, the Goodwood Revival event immerses visitors in the golden age of motorsport, showcasing classic cars and motorcycles that raced between 1948 and 1966. The Goodwood Revival is known for its period-style dress code, where many attendees participate in costumes from the 1940s, 50s, and 60s. Visitors can experience a variety of races, including the Stirling Moss Memorial Trophy, Richmond & Gordon Trophies, and the St Mary's Trophy, among others.
